description: Use this to look up how to do something with AlterLab (API parameters, SDKs, MCP setup, pricing, error codes, migration from Firecrawl/ScrapingBee/Apify) or to find a guide for scraping a specific site. Searches the docs, blog, glossary, comparisons, scrape guides and changelog. Free: needs no API key and never uses credits. Returns the best matches as title, short snippet, url and markdown_url; pass a url to read_alterlab_page to read the full page as markdown.

q.description: What you want to know, in plain words (for example: how to scrape amazon product data).

type.description: Optional content type filter: docs, blog, how-to, scrape, comparison, glossary, answers, changelog or pricing. Omit to search everything.

name: search_alterlab
title: Search AlterLab Docs
